# InteliChart

> InteliChart is a comprehensive patient engagement platform that connects providers with patients through integrated digital tools for scheduling, communication, telehealth, and population health management.

InteliChart's Healthy Outcomes platform serves hospitals, health systems, primary care, specialty care, behavioral health, and long-term care facilities with EHR-integrated solutions designed to improve patient experience, reduce no-shows, and support value-based care initiatives like MIPS compliance.

## Key Topics

- Patient Engagement Platform
- Healthy Outcomes
- EHR Integration
- Patient Portal
- Family Portal
- Patient Scheduling
- Patient Intake
- Telehealth/eHealth
- Population Health
- Patient Activation
- Care Coordination
- MIPS Compliance
- Patient Communication
- Practice Management
- Value-Based Care

## Core Platform & Products

- [Patient Engagement Platform | InteliChart](https://www.intelichart.com): InteliChart homepage: patient engagement platform with API integration for providers.
- [Patient Engagement Platform | InteliChart's Healthy Outcomes](https://www.intelichart.com/healthy-outcomes-platform-overview): Healthy Outcomes comprehensive patient engagement platform overview.
- [Patient Portal Software Vendors | InteliChart](https://www.intelichart.com/patient-portal): Patient Portal product: digital front door for patient engagement and EHR integration.
- [Patient Scheduling Software | InteliChart](https://www.intelichart.com/patient-schedule): Patient Schedule: 24/7 self-service appointment booking and scheduling software.
- [Patient Intake Software | InteliChart](https://www.intelichart.com/patient-intake): Patient Intake: digital forms with OCR and EHR integration for efficient check-in.
- [Patient Reminders | Patient Notify | InteliChart](https://www.intelichart.com/patient-notify): Patient Notify: automated appointment reminders and confirmations to reduce no-shows.
- [Patient Satisfaction Survey | InteliChart](https://www.intelichart.com/patient-survey): PatientSurvey: CAHPS/HCAHPS-compliant satisfaction surveys for patient feedback.

## Clinical & Population Health Solutions

- [Population Health Solutions | InteliChart](https://www.intelichart.com/patient-activate): Patient Activate: population health solution for value-based care and MIPS compliance.
- [Telehealth Providers | eHealth | Intelichart](https://www.intelichart.com/patient-ehealth): Patient eHealth: telehealth platform for seamless virtual care with EHR integration.
- [Patient Engagement Solutions | InteliChart](https://www.intelichart.com/patient-engagement): Healthy Outcomes patient engagement solutions for seamless in-person and digital.

## Industry & Care Setting Solutions

- [Patient Engagement for Hospitals & Health Systems](https://www.intelichart.com/health-system-and-hospital): Hospital and health system patient engagement solutions with integrated tools.
- [Patient Engagement Platform for Primary Care Offices | InteliChart](https://www.intelichart.com/primary-care): Primary care-specific patient engagement platform with population health management.
- [Specialty Care Solutions | InteliChart](https://www.intelichart.com/specialty-care): Healthy Outcomes platform for specialty care delivery and patient engagement.
- [Digital Patient Engagement Platform Multi-Specialty Care | InteliChart](https://www.intelichart.com/multi-specialty-care): Multi-specialty care platform with EHR integration and care coordination.
- [Behavioral Health Technology | InteliChart](https://www.intelichart.com/behaviorial-health): Behavioral health technology with virtual care and patient activation features.
- [Patient Engagement Technology for FHQC & CHC | InteliChart](https://www.intelichart.com/community-health-centers): Patient engagement technology for FQHCs and community health centers.
- [Skilled Nursing, Senior Living & LTC Patient Engagement Technology](https://www.intelichart.com/skilled-nursing-and-senior-living): Family Portal and engagement tools for skilled nursing and senior living facilities.
- [Consumer Engagement in Healthcare | InteliChart](https://www.intelichart.com/consumer-healthcare): Consumer healthcare engagement on Healthy Outcomes platform with digital solutions.

## Family & Long-Term Care

- [Family Engagement and Communication for Long-Term Care | InteliChart](https://www.intelichart.com/family-portal): Family Portal: HIPAA-compliant family engagement for long-term care facilities.
